_note: PixelLab generations for the harbor sheet (art/harbor/build.mjs -> src/art/harbor.*), 2026-10-13. 24 generations in all (balance 2745 before, 2721 after). The cargo stack is hand-pixeled (tools/cargo.mjs, 0 generations).

warehouse_basic.tool: create_map_object 64x80 (w1, w2) and 64x64 (w3, w4), view low top-down, selective outline, detailed shading, high detail
warehouse_basic.rejected: all four: w1 is a narrow gable-front cottage (no width for a 4-tile warehouse), w2-w4 come out in an isometric corner view, not the front-on elevation of the town buildings

warehouse_stylematch.tool: create_map_object style-match mode, 192x128 background (sand + bld:smithy) with a 64x80 custom mask
warehouse_stylematch.rejected: x1: a broken fragment, not a building

warehouse_pro.tool: create_image_pro 64x80, palette Resurrect 64 (64 hex colors), style image bld:workshop + bld:store cut from src/art/buildings.png (uploaded as upload:f0b5de3b-...)
warehouse_pro.used: 0 (front-on timber warehouse, crane on the left end of the roof, ship sign, lantern, brass-hinged double doors, crates): both states, widened by 7 columns and the derelict state drawn over it by rule (tools/warehouse.mjs)
warehouse_pro.rejected: 1 (mast through the front wall), 2 (tall gable, narrow), 3 (busy crane rigging), 4 (no crane), 5 and 7 (pink roof, 7 has no crane), 6 (close to 0, moss-roofed: a fallback), 8 (already weathered: used only as the reference for the derelict look, a different silhouette from 0)

ship.tool: create_map_object 160x120, selective outline, detailed shading, high detail; s1 and s4 view low top-down, s2 and s3 view side
ship.used: s3 (long two-masted steamer, brass stack amidships, row of portholes, gaff mainsail and jib set): graded, copper-sheathed, furled, bobbed and given smoke by tools/ship.mjs
ship.rejected: s1 (single tall mast, yellow-gold hull, the stack in front of the cabin), s2 (one real mast and a big deckhouse: reads as a trawler), s4 (cream-painted hull, cold next to the airship and the town)
